origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: He mea hoʻoheheʻe wai e hoʻohana i ke kai a me ke au hoʻōla.Ma ka home ma ka moana, akā maloʻo i nā ʻāina maloʻo.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: E puhi i ka wai i mua, e hoʻopōʻino i 4 a hoʻokuke aku i nā ʻenemi.5-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: E hoʻokuʻu i kahi nalu ho'ōla e hoʻihoʻi hou i ka 6 HP iā ʻoe a me nā mea pāʻani kokoke.Koina 3 mana.10-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Waiwai
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Hanu i lalo o ka wai no ka pau ʻole.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o ka ʻauʻau ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Hoʻoulu lohi i ke olakino i ka wā i hoʻokomo ʻia i ka wai.
E lawe i ka pōʻino ma nā wao nahele a me nā ʻāina ʻino - hoʻopau ka ea maloʻo i kou ikaika.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: Nawaliwali
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: E hāʻawi i ka pōʻino melee he 25% liʻiliʻi.Kahe kou mana ma ka wai, ʻaʻole ka ʻiʻo.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Ke ahi Mage
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: ʻO kahi pyromancer lele i lei ʻia i ka lapalapa - hoʻolei i nā pōpō ahi, pohā i loko o ka inferno, a puhi i ka poʻe e hahau iā ʻoe.ʻAʻole hiki i ke ahi ke hoʻopōʻino iā ʻoe, akā ʻo ka wai kou make.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Pōpōahi
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: E hoʻolei i ka volley o ʻehā mau pōpō ahi liʻiliʻi ma ke ala āu e nānā nei.Koina 3 mana.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: E hoʻokuʻu i ka lapalapa ahi e hōʻino i nā ʻenemi kokoke.Koina 3 mana.8 kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Lawe nā mea hoʻouka i 30% o ka pōʻino a lākou e hana ai ma ke ʻano he hoʻopaʻi ahi.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: ʻO ka pale ʻana i ke ahi, ka pele, a me ka poʻe pelemaka.Mehana wale ka Lava.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Lawe i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i loko o ka wai a i ʻole ka ua.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Uhi Kuloko
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: He 50% ka wikiwiki o ka pololi mai ka wela o loko.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Air Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: ʻO ka mea hoʻoheheʻe wikiwiki e hoʻolei i ka makani, wili i ka puahiohio o ka neʻe ʻana, a holo i luna i ka lewa.Māmā e like me ka makani, akā palupalu e like me ka lau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: E pana i ka hoʻopiʻi makani e hoʻoulu i ke kīkēkē i ka hopena.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Puhiohio
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: E hoʻolei i ka pahu ea e hoʻoulu ai i ka puahiohio ma ka hopena - huki, hoʻokiʻekiʻe, a wili i nā mea kokoke no ʻehā kekona.Na koina 4 mana.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Hoʻouka hou
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: E hoʻolele iā ʻoe iho i ka lani ma ke kolamu o ka ea.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Mālama ka ea i kou hāʻule - ʻaʻole ʻoe e lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Lawe ʻia e nā huelo mau - neʻe 20% wikiwiki ma ka wāwae.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: huluhulu
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: E iho mālie, me he mea lā ʻaʻole pili ka umekaumaha.E hoʻokuʻu me ke kī akamai inā pono ʻoe e hāʻule wikiwiki.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Pākuʻi Nawaliwali
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 puʻuwai (-4 max HP).ʻAʻole i kūkulu ʻia kahi kino o ka ea e mau ai.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Māmā
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: E hoʻihoʻi hou i 50% hou aʻe - lawe maʻalahi ka makani iā ʻoe.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: ʻO Gravity Mage
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: ʻO kahi warper o nā māla umekaumaha nāna e hoʻohuli i ka lewa iā ia iho.Huki i nā ʻenemi i loko o kahi ʻano hoʻokalakupua a hoʻopau iā lākou - akā ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia kou kino ponoʻī mai ka honua.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Kakaumaha Well
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: E puhi i kahi orb ʻeleʻele e hāʻule i loko o ka lua ʻeleʻele i ka hopena.Huki ʻia nā mea kokoke i kona kikowaena a lawe i ka pōʻino no ʻehā kekona.Na koina 4 mana.20-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: E hoʻokuʻu i kahi hawewe ʻumekaumaha e hoʻopau i nā mea āpau kokoke.Koina 3 mana.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Hiki ke hoʻololi: pale i ka ʻumekaumaha a piʻi i ke kauoha (Levitation I).Paʻa ma ka paʻamau - hoʻololi me ke kī akamai.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_no_fall_da: ʻAʻole hiki iā ʻoe ke lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: E lawe hou i 75% hou aʻe - ʻo kou ʻumekaumaha nāwaliwali e maʻalahi ʻoe e hoʻomaka.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: Nawaliwali
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: E hāʻawi i ka pōʻino melee he 25% liʻiliʻi.Aia kou mana i ka huki ʻana, ʻaʻole i ka kuʻi.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: ʻO ka pōʻeleʻele Mage
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: He kilokilo ulana aka nāna e kāhea i nā ʻōpuni o ka malu a me nā kapuaʻi ma waena o nā loko o ka pouli.ʻAʻahu ʻia a make i ka pō, akā ua hoʻopau ka lā i kou mana.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: E kau i kahi orb aka ma kou wahi e hoʻokau ai i ka Poʻeleʻele a me ka Makapō i nā ʻenemi kokoke.A hiki i 3 orbs e hana i ka manawa hoʻokahi.Koina 3 mana.5-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Teleport i kahi āu e ʻimi nei, a hiki i 24 poloka ka mamao.Koina 2 mana.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: E ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele loa.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: ʻIke ʻia ʻo Mobs iā ʻoe mai 40% wale nō o kā lākou laulā maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Lawe i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: ʻO kaʻu 30% ʻoi aku ka lohi - ʻo ke kukui o nā ʻili i hōʻike ʻia e hōʻeha i kou mau maka.
neoorigins.configuration.hide_hud_bars: Hūnā HUD pā i hoʻohana ʻole ʻia
neoorigins.configuration.sun_damage: Hoʻoponopono ʻia ka pōʻino o ka lā
neoorigins.configuration.dimension_restr: Ka papa inoa hōʻole ʻana o ka mana pākahi
neoorigins.configuration.ocean_origins.d: Ka helu ʻana o ka ea
neoorigins.configuration.ocean_origins.f: Pono ka ʻai iʻa wale nō
neoorigins.configuration.friendly_fire.p: E pale i nā holoholona ʻaloʻalo
E pale i nā golem hao
neoorigins.configuration.sun_damage.helm: He pōʻino paha ka pāpale pāpale
